note: Coordinates a human has pinned, because the geocoder found a different place of the same name. Every entry carries a reason; an override without one is indistinguishable from a typo. The check gate refuses those.
why: The resolver walks a place phrase from longest to shortest — «Arienzo, Caserta», then «Arienzo» — and a miss on the full phrase followed by a hit on the bare name is exactly how you get the wrong town. Those are reported as `loose` by the importer so a human can look.

arienzo.why: The comune of Arienzo in the province of Caserta. The geocoder matched a hamlet of the same name near Salerno, 44 km south — right country, wrong town, and nothing in the build gate could have seen it.

benevento.why: The city of Benevento. The geocoder returned a point 14 km north, which is the province rather than the town.

senja.why: Sv. Juraj of Senj, on the Kvarner coast, and the one case here where the wrong town was found by reading a CASE ENDING as a name. The waypoint «Senja, Sv. Juraj» is a genitive — Sv. Juraj, of Senj — and read as a nominative it matched Senja in Serbia, which exists, 450 km away. The six Roman Catholic registers under it begin in 1695 and come from collection 2040054, «Croatia, Church Books, 1516-1994»; that Serbian ground was Ottoman until 1718 and kept no Catholic parish. Pinned to the gazetteer's Sveti Juraj, 6.9 km from Senj, which puts it back inside the kvarner region and its archive, Državni arhiv u Rijeci.

somerset.why: The English county of Somerset, which is the D'Arcy archive's ground — Chew Magna and Bristol. The geocoder chose a Somerset in Los Angeles County, California, 8,500 km away, because the bare name matches eighteen places in the United States alone.

grad.why: Grad in Prekmurje, Slovenia, not the Grad in Dalmatia. The FamilySearch path for all ten volumes is «Vas > Felsőlendva» — Felsőlendva is the Hungarian name of this Grad, in Vas county — and the collection is «Slovenia, Prekmurje and Međimurje, Civil Registers, 1895-1918», Hungarian-titled (Születtek, Házasultak, Halottak). The point it carried was a population-zero Grad 368 km away, which also put it inside the dalmatia record region and gave it Dalmatian eras it never had. Pinned to the gazetteer's Grad, SI, 46.7976,16.0984 (pop 686), in Prekmurje.

tisina.why: Tišina in Prekmurje, Slovenia. The path is «Vas > Tissina»: Hungarian civil registers filed under Vas county. The Croatian Tišina (Kaptolska) it carried was in Croatia-Slavonia, a separate kingdom, 127 km from Prekmurje, and cannot appear in a Vas county register. Pinned to the gazetteer's Tišina, SI, 46.6542,16.0936 (pop 412).

turnisce.why: Turnišče in Prekmurje, Slovenia. The path is «Zala > Turnischa»: Hungarian civil registers filed under Zala county, which included the Lendava district. The Croatian Turnišće it carried is 150 km from Međimurje, the part of Croatia that was in Zala. Pinned to the gazetteer's Turnišče, SI, 46.6257,16.3139 (pop 1,509).

svjakovsiljevica.why: Sv. Jakov-Šiljevica, now Jadranovo, on the Kvarner coast, not a Šiljevica in central Serbia. The register is Roman Catholic, in «Croatia, Church Books, 1516-1994»; the gazetteer's Jadranovo (pop 1,077) lists «Sveti Jakov Siljevica» among its alternate names. Pinned to the gazetteer's Jadranovo, HR, 45.2311,14.6183.

bale.why: Bale (Valle d'Istria) in Istria, Croatia, not a Bale in Montenegro 503 km away. Eight Roman Catholic volumes in «Croatia, Church Books», some from 1538; the place already carried «Valle» and «Valle d'Istria» as names, and Valle is Bale's Italian name. Pinned to the gazetteer's Bale, HR, 45.0406,13.7836 (pop 973).

klasnic.why: Klasnić, in the Glina area of Croatia, not a Klašnić in central Serbia. The register is Orthodox, in «Croatia, Church Books». The gazetteer holds two villages, Donji Klasnić (45.2293,16.1636) and Gornji Klasnić (45.2375,16.1378), 2.5 km apart, and nothing in the path says which, so the point is the midpoint between them and not either village. Pinned to the midpoint of Donji and Gornji Klasnić, HR.

hum.why: Hum in Istria, Croatia (the Buzet area, the town of 52), not a Hum in Slovenia 100 km away. The place is named «Hum (Buzet)» and its Roman Catholic registers are in «Croatia, Church Books». Pinned to the gazetteer's Hum, HR, 45.3481,14.05.

starigrad.why: Stari Grad on the island of Hvar, not the point in the north of Croatia it carried, 330 km away. The place is named «Stari Grad (Hvar)». Pinned to the gazetteer's Stari Grad, HR, 43.1839,16.5978 (pop 1,921).

new-york-us.why: The State of New York. A division's dot is the population-weighted centre of its towns of 5,000 or more, and for New York that centre (40.9571,-74.1556) falls in Passaic County, New Jersey, because New York City and Long Island lie so close to the Hudson that they drag the mean across the state line: a record for New York in 1920 was being answered with New Jersey's jurisdiction. Pinned to Pearl River, Rockland County, NY (gazetteer 41.059,-74.0218, pop 15,876), the nearest sizeable town inside the state, 16 km from the old point, so promote-admin-divisions.py still finds the row as its twin (it matches within 120 km) and does not draw a second one.

torino.why: Turin. The only volume is «Italy, Torino, Diocese of Torino, Catholic Church Records, 1801-1899», a diocesan collection for the city, and the point it carried was Torino di Sangro in Abruzzo, 560 km from the diocese. Pinned to the gazetteer's Turin, IT, 45.0705,7.6868.

trstenik.why: Trstenik on Pelješac (Orebić), the only gazetteer Trstenik in Dubrovnik-Neretva county; the old point was Trstenik Nartski near Zagreb. Was drawn at 45.77647,16.17702.

soline.why: Soline on Dugi Otok (Sali), whose church of St James is a parish church (hr.wikipedia «Soline (Sali)»); the Zadar State Archive inventory HR-DAZD-378 lists Soline births 1794-1931, the years of these books. The old point was Soline near Dubrovnik. Was drawn at 42.61472,18.22222.

podgrae.why: Podgrađe near Omiš, the gazetteer's only Podgrađe in the Omiš municipality; HR-DAZD-378 books 835-836 carry these years. The old point was a Podgrađe in northern Croatia. Was drawn at 46.0232,16.09168.

popovici.why: Popović in the Benkovac municipality (gazetteer also «Popovići»); HR-DAZD-378 «Popović» books 853, 1695 carry these years. The old point was Popovići in Konavle. Was drawn at 42.52278,18.31861.

draga.why: Draga beside Rijeka, the gazetteer namesake 5 km from the city; the FamilySearch parish is «Draga (Rijeka)». The old point was Draga Požeška in Slavonia. Was drawn at 45.43833,17.62472.

srednjeselo.why: Srednje Selo on Šolta: HR-DAZD-378 heads it «Srednje Selo (Villa Media; otok Šolta)». The old point was a Srednje Selo in Požega-Slavonia. Was drawn at 45.32444,17.75861.

selina.why: Seline near Starigrad, Zadar county. HR-DAZD-378 «Seline» holds births 1825-1861, marriages 1825-1853, deaths 1826-1875 and a status animarum of the early 19th century, matching these FamilySearch volumes. The old point was Selina in Istria. Was drawn at 45.15694,13.77194.

ostrvica.why: Ostrvica beside Gospić (gazetteer, same municipality). The old point was Ostrvica near Omiš. Was drawn at 43.45,16.75.

dubovac.why: Dubovac in Karlovac, the gazetteer namesake 2 km from the city. The old point was 134 km east, near an airfield of the same name. Was drawn at 45.24111,17.205.

kamenica.why: Kamenica near Ivanec, the gazetteer's only Kamenica in Varaždin county. The old point was Kamenica Skradnička near Ogulin. Was drawn at 45.23012,15.34759.

opatovac.why: Opatovac near Vukovar, the gazetteer namesake in Vukovar-Srijem county. The old point was an Opatovac near Nova Gradiška. Was drawn at 45.3282,17.43368.

obljaj.why: Veliki Obljaj in the town of Glina, which has a Serbian Orthodox church (en.wikipedia «Veliki Obljaj»); Mali Obljaj is 3 km away. The old point was an Obljaj in Lika. Was drawn at 44.54,15.9575.

otok-vinkovci.why: Otok near Vinkovci. These books are FamilySearch parish «Otok (Vinkovci)»; they had been listed on the row named «Otok (Sinj)».

otok.why: Otok near Sinj. The row had carried the books and the point of Otok (Vinkovci), now a row of its own. Was drawn at 45.14667,18.88389.

gorica-zadar.why: Gorica near Raštane and Sukošan. These books are FamilySearch parish «Gorica (Zadar)» and match HR-DAZD-378 «Gorica (vidi i Raštane)», except the births of 1759-1810, which the archive lists under Pag-Gorica (book 783) while FamilySearch files them here; not opened.

gorica.why: Gorica on the island of Pag (HR-DAZD-378 «Pag - Gorica»). The row had carried the books of Gorica (Zadar), now a row of its own, and a point in Istria. Was drawn at 45.14167,14.01528.

poljica-krk.why: Poljica on the island of Krk. These books are FamilySearch parish «Poljica (Krk)»; they had been listed on the row named «Poljica (Imotski)».

poljica.why: Poljica near Imotski; HR-DAZD-378 «Poljica (Imotski)» books 847-852. The row had carried the books of Poljica (Krk), now a row of its own, and a point near Trogir. Was drawn at 43.52073,16.13471.

kamensko-pozega.why: Kamenska (also «Bučko Kamensko», «Kamensko») in the Brestovac municipality, the gazetteer settlement near Požega that answers to Kamensko. These are the Orthodox books FamilySearch files as «Kamensko (Slavonska Požega)»; they had been listed on the row named «Kamensko (Karlovac)».

kamensko.why: Kamensko in the city of Karlovac, the gazetteer namesake 5 km from it. The old point was a Kamensko in Split-Dalmatia, and the Orthodox books of Kamensko (Slavonska Požega) are now a row of their own. Was drawn at 43.61694,16.95306.
